feeding_claim.verbatim: We raise our 100% grass-fed beef and lamb on our certified organic pastures in the hills of Vermont.

local_areas: parts of VT, CT, MA, and RI

notes: Delivery runs on set dates with a $249 minimum; farm pickup on specific dates. Nationwide shipping is stated only for wool and tallow goods, not meat. 1/4 and 1/2 beef share and whole lamb share deposits. Homepage metadata mentions raw milk but no dairy herd or milk sales were found, so dairy left out. Organic pasture claim not checked against a certifier. Category cautious grass-fed: 100% grass-fed, finishing unstated.
